feedback-danger.$description: Dark is red-400 so error text clears 4.5:1 on surface-raised and surface-sunken (red-500 was 4.46:1). Set here, not in semantic, because Sneaks and Survivor inherit the semantic value.

feedback-warning-fg.$description: yellow-900 so badge text clears 4.5:1 on feedback-warning-bg (yellow-800 was 4.36:1). Set here, not in semantic, because Kooky, Sneaks and Survivor inherit the semantic value.
